english.title: Packer/importer fail to keep record of proposed marking on package not marked
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[packer]_
(B)_[importer]_

of a package of **(..SPECIFY CONTENTS..) which was not marked with the nominal quantity as mentioned in regulation 5(1)(a) of the Weights and Measures (Packaged Goods) Regulations 2006 at the time when it was

(C)_[made up,]_
(D)_[imported,]_

failed to carry out your duty to decide what you proposed to mark on the package in pursuance of that regulation and to make at that time, and to maintain until such time as the package was so marked, a record of the same
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(2), 13(1) and 18(1) of the Weights and Measures (Packaged Goods) Regulations 2006.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 2 for definition of 'packer' and 'package'
(ii) Regulation 10(4) provides that proceedings for an offence under these Regulations, other than an offence under regulation 16, shall not be instituted after the expiration of the period of twelve months beginning with the date when the offence was committed.
(iii) It shall be a defence to prove that the defendant took all reasonable precautions and exercised all due diligence to avoid the commission of the offence - regulation 19(4)
